'''Black Hide''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Wyrd]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[The Dweller]]'''.<ref name="inara-black-hide">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52127/ Black Hide in Wyrd — Station], Inara.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Wyrd]]
* '''Body:''' Wyrd A 2
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-black-hide" />

== Engineer ==

Black Hide is operated by '''[[The Dweller]]'''. He is one of the independent starting Engineers — see [[The Dweller]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access his workshop.

== Station Services ==

Black Hide offers a commodity market, outfitting, refuelling, repairs, and shipyard services, in addition to The Dweller's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-black-hide" />
